summary: Completed testing of 6 Super Admin features. All 17 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: Delete admin endpoint, Dashboard shows user/admin counts with progress bars, Organization deactivate/reactivate, Login blocking for inactive orgs, Sectors CRUD with defaults, Conversion rules in formulas, Facility sector dropdown from API.

issues: Minor React hydration warning: <span> inside <select> - cosmetic only, not affecting functionality

feature_1_delete_admin.details: DELETE /api/super-admin/admins/{admin_id} endpoint exists and works. Returns 404 for non-existent admin, 200 for successful delete.
feature_1_delete_admin.screenshot: Admin Management page shows 13 admins with delete (trash) buttons on each card

feature_2_dashboard_counts.details: Super Admin Dashboard displays 4 summary cards: Total Organizations (7), Total Facilities (12), Total Admins (11), Total Users (6). Organization cards show Facilities/Admins/Users counts with progress bars for limits.

feature_3_org_deactivate_reactivate.details: PUT /api/super-admin/organizations/{id}/reactivate endpoint exists. DELETE marks org as is_active=False and blocks users. Reactivate reverses this.
feature_3_org_deactivate_reactivate.screenshot: Organizations page shows toggle (power) buttons on each of 7 org cards

feature_4_login_blocked_inactive_org.details: Login endpoint (server.py lines 451-454) checks org.is_active and returns 403 'Your organization has been deactivated' for users of inactive orgs.

feature_5_sectors_crud.details: GET /api/sectors returns 10 predefined sectors (Manufacturing, Transportation, Energy, Agriculture, Construction, Retail, Healthcare, Technology, Finance, Other). POST/PUT/DELETE work for super admin only.

feature_6_conversion_rules.details: conversion_rules field accepts array of {unit, multiplier, formula} objects in calculation formulas. Successfully created and retrieved formula with conversion rules.

feature_7_facility_sector_dropdown.details: Facility form sector dropdown is populated from GET /api/sectors. Shows all 10 predefined sectors.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React hydration warning in Facilities.js - span inside select element at line 270. This is a cosmetic issue that doesn't affect functionality.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test data
